snippet.title: Visionz44   Shark Attack Game play Video
snippet.description: Gameplay clip of Shark Attack, an interactive Twitch chat game. Viewers type commands like !hunt, !attack, and !bite directly in Twitch chat, and a real-time browser overlay reacts with catch results, boss HP, and other live events.
